annotations.title: Reverse postings & defunct a wrong agreement

description: Retire a WRONG agreement that has already accrued — reverse its postings, then archive it. Voiding alone only stops FUTURE accruals; this UNWINDS what already accrued by appending a Reversal for every earning event (earned → $0, strictly append-only — the originals AND the reversals both stay on the ledger for audit), then voids the agreement. Call WITHOUT confirm first to DRY-RUN — it reports how many postings and how much $ will be reversed and warns if any was already settled (a clawback). Call again with confirm:true to apply. Refuses if the agreement is posted to the ERP (supersede it instead). Needs the agreement_id. Requires a connected Aurgus account.

confirm.description: Omit/false to DRY-RUN (preview the reversal); true to actually reverse the postings and archive the agreement.

name: defunct_agreement
